keyFiles.what: The entry point — what this package hands to everyone else.
All of the grouping, as pure functions: events become episodes (one per thing that happened) and sources (who set it off).
The shell — the header, the three filters, and the two panes; every filter's state lives in the URL.
The daemon reads: a polled status probe plus a cursor-paged feed that fetches until the selected window is covered.
